name: Baierbach (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of red, white and blue, charged above the centre with the municipal arms of Baierbach (a saltire and a wolf's head over water).
history: Municipal flag of Baierbach; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Baierbach arms — saltire and wolf's head
